rapport_notes: Calm under sticker-shock objection, offered the walkthrough as a solution rather than losing the lead outright.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A - customer declined the virtual walkthrough and no concern was raised during discovery (the price pushback came only after the estimate was delivered)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "the last time we take the less money end up spending by the end of the day" and "if we just have extra time just to prepare but in the small items into your boxes yourself"

top_strength: When the customer balked at the square-footage-based estimate, the rep calmly reintroduced the virtual walkthrough as a way to right-size the crew count rather than just losing the lead.
coaching_note: The virtual walkthrough should have been pitched more assertively as the default before quoting off square footage alone, since the sticker shock was largely a function of overestimating crew size.
